name: weekly-work-report
description: Create a one-page Korean software weekly work report from OneNote task histories while preserving an existing Excel template.

interface.shortDescription: OneNote 이력을 기존 Excel 양식의 한 페이지 보고서로 작성
interface.longDescription: Reads the 동원정밀 OneNote Dashboard and linked task histories, classifies Completed and Doing work, and patches a copied XLSX template without rebuilding its worksheet package.
